item.title: Marvel’s Kevin Feige Breaks Silence on MCU Doctor Doom Being a Tony Stark Variant
item.description: Robert Downey Jr. 's surprise casting as Doctor Doom in December's Avengers: Doomsday resulted in Marvel fans wondering if the Doomsday villain would be a multiversal variant of Tony Stark/Iron Man, the character Downey played for over a decade. More fuel was added to the fire when Red Guardian actor David Harbour hinted that Doom's face would be revealed to look like Stark back in August, but the actor later walked back those comments .

item.title: Cursed treasure hours schedule in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.description: Fortnite is continuing the tradition of special Saturday hourly events during the Chapter 7 mini season , though this time they're treasure hours , centered around the pirate-themed "Treasure Hunters" season. During these hours, certain sprites will get increased drop rates, and you'll drop into the game with special items.

item.title: Xbox CEO Hints Its Studios Will Heavily Use AI to Make Future Games
item.description: This Sunday marks 25 years of Xbox . To commemorate the occasion, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma wrote a lengthy post on X cataloging Microsoft’s long history with gaming that goes back long before the original Xbox was released on Nov. 15, 2001. However, while the post mostly reads like a typical anniversary blog from a gaming executive, the last chunk implies the company may be going in a new direction with the most controversial technology of the moment: generative AI .

item.title: All 22 Call of Duty Campaigns, Ranked From Worst to Best
item.description: There are a whopping 23 mainline Call of Duty games, and 22 of them have campaigns. (We don't talk about Black Ops 4 deciding to go without.) From the long-running adventures of Captain Price and co. in the Modern Warfare series to Mason, Woods, and Reznov in Black Ops; not to mention the various standalone games such as Vanguard , Advanced Warfare , and WWII — many of them are packed full of epic, memorable moments.

item.title: Disney Plus Is Officially the New Streaming Home of the Game Awards
item.description: In a first for the show, this year's Game Awards will be available to stream on Disney Plus . This is just one additional way to watch the game industry's version of the Oscars, on top of the usual Twitch and YouTube livestreams. The announcement simultaneously expands the offerings on Disney's streaming service and further boosts the awards show's profile.

item.title: Ex-Overwatch 2 Lead: Blizzard Execs Pushing Overwatch 2’s Reveal Were ‘Fucking Idiots’
item.description: Former Blizzard game director Jeff Kaplan left the company five years ago , but the studio's Overwatch fumbles are still fresh in his mind, judging by frank remarks he shared during a podcast. In it, the former face of the hero shooter described what was happening behind the scenes leading up to Blizzard's surprise announcement of Overwatch 2. Kaplan said there was deep dysfunction at the executive level within the company.

item.title: Where to find the Daikoku area in Forza Horizon 6
item.description: In Forza Horizon 6 , you can visit Daikoku , a famous area for those who enjoy Japanese automotive culture. It's located in the Tokyo City region and, in real life, it's well-known for hosting car meets — just like the in-game ones you can take part in if you stop by the Daikoku Parking Area.

item.title: Star Wars 50th Anniversary Release Will Include New Music from John Williams
item.description: Star Wars is celebrating its 50th anniversary in 2027. The original cut of the first film (later subtitled Episode IV – A New Hope ) will hit theaters in February , and it will be accompanied by brief new music from longtime Star Wars composer John Williams.

item.title: All battle pass skins in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.description: Fortnite 's Chapter 7 mini season , "Treasure Hunters," has kicked off, bringing a smaller battle pass alongside it (as one would expect from a shorter season). This battle pass is full of goodies, including two outfits featuring characters from One Piece and some anime-styled Fortnite characters.

item.title: Witcher Multiplayer Game Adds Key Writer From Baldur’s Gate 3
item.description: CD Projekt Red has a lot of irons in the proverbial fire right now, one being a Witcher multiplayer game codenamed Project Sirius . While it was first revealed back in 2022 alongside other projects that would later be confirmed as The Witcher 4 and a remake of the original Witcher , Sirius has had a troubled development thus far. CD Projekt Red continues to add talent to the project, however, with the latest addition being one of the writers behind some of Baldur's Gate 3 's best storylines.
